name: Beeyu Overseas Ltd
about: Incorporated in 1993, Beeyu Overseas Ltd is in the Tea plantation business[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1][2][3]
BOL was in the business of Tea Plantation. It had Tea Gardens at Ooty in Tamil Nadu. Currently, they have discontinued their manufacturing activities and is looking for another line of business. They have also leased out their office in Kolkata.

cons: Stock is trading at 397 times its book value
Company has low interest coverage ratio.
Company has a low return on equity of -43.3% over last 3 years.
